ground_truth_check.query: Does the 'Anthropic MCP Hub' exist as a paid MCP marketplace as of May 2026?
ground_truth_check.result: No. There is no official source confirming a paid MCP marketplace or hub called 'Anthropic MCP Hub' as of May 22, 2026. This appears to be a hallucination.

evidence.anthropic_blog: Checked anthropic.com/news. No posts about a paid MCP marketplace or hub. Last relevant post: 'Introducing the Model Context Protocol' (November 25, 2024) which describes MCP as an open protocol, not a marketplace.
evidence.anthropic_github: Checked github.com/anthropics. No repository named 'mcp-hub' or similar. The 'modelcontextprotocol' organization (github.com/modelcontextprotocol) hosts the spec and servers, but no paid directory.
evidence.anthropic_docs: Checked docs.anthropic.com. Documentation covers MCP protocol and server implementation, but no mention of a paid hub or marketplace.
evidence.hub.anthropic.com: Domain does not resolve to a public website. No evidence of existence.
evidence.third_party_sources: No credible tech news outlets (e.g., TechCrunch, The Verge) or community forums (e.g., Reddit r/ClaudeAI) report a paid MCP marketplace from Anthropic as of May 2026.

ground_truth_check.conclusion: The 'Anthropic MCP Hub' is a hallucination. Do not include it in any output. Focus on real, existing platforms and protocols.
